name: Marie Van Vorst
bio: Marie Van Vorst (1867–1936) was an American novelist, poet and journalist, born in New York City and later resident in Europe.
Her lyric “Sing Again” was printed in the additional selections of Stedman’s An American Anthology (1900).

poems.title: Sing Again
poems.author: Marie Van Vorst
poems.collection: An American Anthology, 1787–1900, ed. E. C. Stedman (1900)
poems.text:
You sang me a song:
’T was the close of the year—
Sing again!
I cannot remember the name
Or the words:
’T is the same
We listen to hear
When the windows are open in spring,
And the air’s full of birds;
One calls from the branch some sweet thing,
And one sings on the wing
The refrain.

You sang me a song
My heart thrilled to hear.
The refrain
Has run like a fillet of gold
Through the woof
Of the cold
Dark days of a year.
To-night there ’s a year at its start,
All the birds are aloof,
Your eyes hold the sun for my part,
And the Spring’s in your heart—
Sing again!
